interpretation.summary: cannot read config ./ops/goatbuilder/goatbuilder.yaml: No such file or directory (os error 2)

entry.title: the site's declared end state cannot be derived or read
entry.what: endstate derives what a site should run from its own declarations (group_vars, the fleet pin table, the inventory) and the service catalog, then reads the site's hosts once over Ansible. One of those could not start, so nothing was graded.
causes: the site name has no ops/ansible/group_vars/<site>_hosts/ directory
python3 or PyYAML is not installed on this machine
the catalog file ops/goatbuilder/endstate/catalog.yaml does not parse
fixes: ls ops/ansible/group_vars/   (the site names this repository declares)
python3 ops/goatbuilder/endstate/endstate.py model <site>   (the derived end state, without reading any host)

entry.title: the config does not validate
entry.what: ops/goatbuilder/goatbuilder.yaml failed the versioned schema or a cross-field rule. The config is generated; fix the source and regenerate.
causes: a hand edit to the generated file
a pins or ladder change the generator was not run for

entry.title: the partner named to `federate status` is not a declared peering
entry.what: `goatbuilder federate status <partner>` reads a peering declared in goatbuilder.yaml `peerings:` (on `--env`, when given). The name given is not one of them, so nothing was read.
causes: the name is misspelled, or the peering is declared under another environment's config
the peering has not been declared yet
fixes: declare it under peerings: in goatbuilder.yaml first (C1)
